value.message: Seattle YMCA has preschool swim lessons (Stage 2 to 4) - their site says the winter session runs Jan 1 to Feb 28, 2027, with registration opened Oct 15 for members and Oct 22 for the community. Seattle Parks and Recreation lists preschool lessons at Ballard Pool and Meadowbrook Pool, but I could not get into their pages today to pin down days or prices; I'll keep watching and text you when I have them.
